name: refuse-render-only-code
description: A REGISTERED code whose surfaces exclude mcp-endpoint has no transport envelope: the per-app endpoint's authorization never speaks it, and a projector that types it anyway would put a render-gate state on a surface the registry does not list. The three auth arms (no issuer, foreign issuer, denied subject) stay the bare 403 by the same rule — naming any of them would say which is true.

refusal.message: the configured allowance for this app is exhausted
refusal.fix: top up the allowance for this app, then retry
